content: मोक्षणम् [मोक्ष्-ल्युट्] .²1 Releasing, liberating, emancipating, setting at liberty; यावानवध्यस्य वधे तावान् वध्यस्य मोक्षणे <ls>Ms. 9. 249</ls>. .²2 Releasing, deliverance. .²3 Loosening, untying. .²4 Giving up, abandoning, resigning. .²5 Shedding. .²6 Squandering. .²7 Discharging, casting; शस्त्र˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-णी@} The magic art of releasing any one.
